### T10. Wallets whose landed buys switch between single-service paths (possible separate-tx fan-out race)

If such a wallet sends one copy per service with a durable nonce, only the fastest copy can land, so the landed mix = race wins. Without a nonce several copies can land (then 'launches with 2+ buys' is high) and the mix is just routing.

### T13. Race among 150 durable-nonce fan-out wallets: which path's copy lands (same wallet, same leader client)

Wallets: ≥15 launches, first buy per launch, ≥2 paths each ≥5% of their launches, ≤5% extra buys (double landings), durable nonce in the RPC sample. If such a wallet sends one copy per path at the same time (INFERRED from nonce + switching paths + no double buys), the landed path = the copy that arrived first. Pairwise share = A's wins / (A's + B's wins) summed over wallet×client cells where both won at least once; wallet-majority = share of those cells where A won more often. We only see winners: a path a wallet sends to but never wins with is invisible, and each wallet's own tip per path is part of the race.
